caption: A magnet is slid up the outside of a glass of water, and a steel nut lying at the bottom rises up the inside of the glass behind it.

sa.check: A glass of water with a steel nut lying at the bottom.
A magnet is slid up the outside of the glass.
The nut rises up the inside of the glass behind the magnet.
The nut stays on the inner face of the glass, opposite the magnet.
The magnet's movement comes first and the nut follows.

pc.expect: The nut moves only where and when the magnet moves, staying opposite it on the inner face, and stops when the magnet stops.
pc.fail: The nut moves in a different direction from the magnet; or keeps rising after the magnet has stopped; or stays at the bottom while the magnet passes up beside it; or the nut sets off before the magnet has moved.

pc.expect: The glass wall stays between magnet and nut: the nut stays inside the water and the magnet outside; neither passes through the glass.
pc.fail: The nut passes through the glass onto the magnet; or the magnet passes into the water; or nut and magnet are seen touching with no glass between; or the nut passes through the bottom of the glass.

pc.expect: If the magnet is taken away the nut sinks back down through the water; the water stays level in the glass.
pc.fail: The nut hangs in the water with the magnet gone; or rises on its own; or the water heaps up on the magnet's side; or the water rises out of the glass.

pc.expect: The nut is a hard piece that slides along the inner face; the glass stays rigid; the water moves only in small ripples.
pc.fail: The nut squashes against the glass; or the glass bends where the magnet presses; or the water moves as a solid block; or the nut leaves a groove in the glass.

pc.expect: One nut, one magnet, one glass; nothing appears, vanishes or merges.
pc.fail: A second nut appears; or the nut vanishes; or nut and magnet fuse; or the glass duplicates or changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The glass, the water's colour and the magnet stay the same.
pc.fail: The water changes colour; or the magnet changes colour or shape; or the glass changes shape.
